name: Report Specification 4
definition: Specifies the parameters for which a transaction report must be generated.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to a transaction, for which the matching application must generate a report.

TransactionStatus.name: Transaction Status
TransactionStatus.definition: Identifies the status of the transaction by means of a code.

SubmitterTransactionReference.name: Submitter Transaction Reference
SubmitterTransactionReference.definition: Reference to the identification of a transaction of a user, for which the matching application must generate a report.

EntitiesToBeReported.name: Entities To Be Reported
EntitiesToBeReported.definition: Specifies a list of entities for which the matching application must generate a report.

Correspondent.name: Correspondent
Correspondent.definition: Financial institution that is the counterparty to the trade transaction.

SubmittingBank.name: Submitting Bank
SubmittingBank.definition: Financial institution that is a data set submitting bank to the transaction.

ObligorBank.name: Obligor Bank
ObligorBank.definition: Financial institution that is an obligor bank to the transaction.

Buyer.name: Buyer
Buyer.definition: Party that buys goods or services, or a financial instrument.

Seller.name: Seller
Seller.definition: Party that sells goods or services, or a financial instrument.

CorrespondentCountry.name: Correspondent Country
CorrespondentCountry.definition: Country of the financial institution which is the other party to the trade.

PendingRequestForAction.name: Pending Request For Action
PendingRequestForAction.definition: Specifies a pending request for action for which the matching application must generate a report.
